abstract: The incidence of mononuclear cell (MNC) infiltrates was studied in the testes of the following: 45 patients with carcinoma in situ (CIS) as the only lesion in the testis, CIS accompanied by an early invasion of CIS or CIS accompanied by invasive germ cell tumour (GCT) of the testis; 100 men and 146 boys who had died suddenly and unexpectedly, and 100 infertility patients. The results suggest that (1) the incidence of MNC infiltration increases with increasing severity of testicular malignant changes, (2) increased MNC infiltration is also evident in the contralateral testis where no malignant cells can be observed, (3) the incidence of MNC infiltration in men who died suddenly is not different from that in men who have had their testes biopsied because of infertility, and (4) the incidence of MNC infiltration is high in testes of boys younger than 1 year of age.
abstract_ja: 上皮内癌(CIS)のみを精巣に認めた45例、CISに加えてCISの早期浸潤または浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)を伴う症例、突然かつ予期せず死亡した男性100例および男児146例、不妊症患者100例の精巣における単核細胞(MNC)浸潤の頻度を検討しました。結果から、(1)MNC浸潤の頻度は精巣の悪性変化の重症度とともに増加する、(2)悪性細胞が認められない対側精巣にもMNC浸潤の増加がみられる、(3)突然死した男性のMNC浸潤頻度は、不妊症のため精巣生検を受けた男性と差がない、(4)生後1歳未満の男児の精巣ではMNC浸潤の頻度が高い、ことが示唆されました。
